Theorem
1. Theorem 5.22\group ch05-viscosity-solutions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0118, han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0119 ↗ hanlin:ch05-lem-5-23 Let $p>n$ and let $u\in C(B_1)$ be a viscosity solution of \[ a_{ij}D_{ij}u=f\quad \text{in }B_1. \] There is $\varepsilon >0$, depending only on $n,\lambda ,\Lambda ,p$, such that if \[ \left(\frac1{|B_r(x_0)|}\int _{B_r(x_0)} |a_{ij}-a_{ij}(x_0)|^n\right)^{1/n}\leq \varepsilon \] for every $B_r(x_0)\subset B_1$, then $u\in W^{2,p}_{\mathrm{loc}}(B_1)$ and \[ \| u\| _{W^{2,p}(B_{1/2})} \leq C\left(\| u\| _{L^\infty (B_1)}+\| f\| _{L^p(B_1)}\right), \] where $C$ depends only on $n,\lambda ,\Lambda ,p$.
Proof

\sketch Normalize $u$ and $f$ on balls compactly contained in $B_1$, apply Lemma 4, and cover $B_{1/2}$ by finitely many such balls.

□
